map.心率恢复指数是做什么的？: What does Heart Rate Recovery Index (HRR) do?
map.如何使用心率恢复指数？: How do I use Heart Rate Recovery Index (HRR)?
map.心率恢复指数适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Heart Rate Recovery Index (HRR) best for?
map.输入运动停止时心率及恢复 1/2/3 分钟后的心率，计算心率恢复值 HRR，评估: Enter the heart rate at exercise cessation and at 1/2/3 minutes of recovery to compute heart rate recovery (HRR) and assess cardiovascular function and recovery capacity.
map.HRR 恢复 = (运动心率−恢复心率)/运动心率: HRR recovery = (exercise HR − recovery HR)/exercise HR
map.恢复 1 分钟心率 (bpm): Heart rate after 1 minute of recovery (bpm)
map.恢复 2 分钟心率 (bpm): Heart rate after 2 minutes of recovery (bpm)
map.恢复 3 分钟心率 (bpm): Heart rate after 3 minutes of recovery (bpm)
map.💡 HRR₁ = 峰值心率 − 恢复1分钟心率；HRR₁＜12 提示心血管风险升: 💡 HRR₁ = peak heart rate − heart rate after 1 minute of recovery; HRR₁ < 12 suggests elevated cardiovascular risk, >= 30 is excellent; the steeper the recovery curve the better
map.测试方法：运动至接近最大心率后立即停止，坐下静息，记录停止时及第 1、2、3 分: Test method: exercise to near maximal heart rate, then stop immediately and sit at rest, recording the heart rate at cessation and at minutes 1, 2, and 3
map.HRR₁（1 分钟恢复值）是临床常用的心血管风险筛查指标，偏低需警惕: HRR₁ (the 1-minute recovery value) is a clinically common cardiovascular risk screening metric; a low value warrants caution
map.恢复心率受体能、年龄、药物（β受体阻滞剂）影响，需结合个体情况判断: Recovery heart rate is affected by fitness, age, and medication (beta-blockers); judge in light of individual circumstances
map.恢复 3 分钟心率仍高于峰值 80% 提示恢复能力较弱: A 3-minute recovery heart rate still above 80% of peak indicates weak recovery
map.本工具纯前端运行，数据不会上传到服务器，结果仅供参考，不作为诊断依据: This tool runs entirely in the browser and does not upload data to a server; results are for reference only and are not a diagnostic basis
map.运动后心率回落速度。: How fast heart rate falls after exercise.
map.训练后用 1 分钟心率回落值评估心血管适应，回落慢提示恢复或体能不足。: After training, use the 1-minute heart-rate drop to assess cardiovascular adaptation; a slow drop indicates insufficient recovery or fitness.
map.运动末 170 bpm，停 1 分钟降至 140 → HRR=30 bpm（≥2: At the end of exercise 170 bpm, dropping to 140 after 1 minute -> HRR = 30 bpm (>= 20 is mostly good).
map.提示心肺适能或恢复不足。: It indicates insufficient cardiorespiratory fitness or recovery.
map.健康成人运动后 1 分钟降 12–20+ bpm，<12 关联较高心血管风险，需: Healthy adults drop 12-20+ bpm in the first minute after exercise; <12 is associated with higher cardiovascular risk and needs attention.
map.心率恢复指数（HRR）工具，输入运动停止时心率及恢复第 1、2、3 分钟心率，计: The Heart Rate Recovery Index (HRR) tool takes the heart rate at exercise cessation and at recovery minutes 1, 2, and 3, computes the HRR at each time point, the 1-minute drop ratio, the first-2-minute recovery rate, and the 3-minute residual ratio, and rates cardiovascular recovery based on HRR₁ — a common simple metric for cardiorespiratory function and cardiovascular risk screening.
